finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: military barracks with blue banners and training dummies; military sentry post with shield emblem; small stone castle; straight stone defensive wall section. Row 2: corner stone defensive wall section; stone city gate; friendly armored town guard with spear; storybook bandit carrying loot bag. Row 3: bandit camp with tent and loot; cottage marked by illness with subdued green haze; isolated stylized pale green plague cloud status effect; quarantine warning marker with medicinal leaf emblem. Family friendly, no gore. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet. OVERRIDE COMPOSITION: make each sprite miniature, only 55% of cell width and height. Huge transparent padding. Plague cloud is a small contained symbol WITHOUT spreading haze. Buildings must NOT fill cells. No cropped flag or smoke. This is essential for slicing.
